subject: REPOSITORY paragraph (when the AS phrase is required)
notes: A.1 item 163 - REPOSITORY paragraph (when the AS phrase is required), 12.3.8 GR2, required + documented. docs/CONFORMANCE.md s7's determination: the AS phrase is NEVER required; with it the declared word names the definition whose externalized name is the literal, without it a program specifier's externalized name is the word (GR10 NOTE 1) and a class / interface / function specifier names the group's definition declared with that word (GR6/GR9 implementor latitude). kb/Work PB974.
